title: Marcos swears in newly promoted teachers in Cagayan Valley

blocks.text: SANTIAGO CITY – A total of 4,244 promoted teachers and non-teaching personnel in Cagayan Valley formally took their oaths before President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.at the Santiago City Sports Arena in Barangay Baluarte on Friday. “This event marks the implementation of the administration of the Expanded Career Progression (ECP) System designed to strengthen the regional workforce and basic education support,” Marcos said. The President later visited the Patul Elementary School here to witness the school feeding program for learners and to inspect the school’s facilities and condition after a brief meeting.
